title: No physicists on the claimed crash retrieval program and the stalled physics are two sides of one coin
summary: Eric Weinstein tells of No physicists on the claimed crash retrieval program and the stalled physics are two sides of one coin, about 1970s-present at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I guess my question to you is are these two sides of the same coin that we don't make progress beyond the standard model and general relativity and we don't have any physicists on the UFO UAP claimed crash retrieval program.

plain: Eric Weinstein, a researcher, put a question to a Pentagon scientist on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels. He asks whether two things are connected: physics has not moved past its two main theories, the standard model of particles and Einstein's theory of gravity, since about the 1970s, and, he says, no physicists work on the claimed crash retrieval program, a supposed secret effort to recover crashed craft. If they are linked, it would mean secrecy itself has stalled science.
